summaryZh: TEMP Lab 研究不同尺度的热输运、能量转换、储存和管理，重点开发热电转换纳米结构材料与器件，并研究微纳尺度电子、声子和光子的输运物理。
researchQuestions: 如何通过纳米结构材料和器件实现热能到电能的转换？
微纳尺度电荷与热载流子的输运规律是什么？
topics: 热输运、转换、储存与管理
methods: 纳米结构材料与器件开发
微纳尺度输运物理研究

evidence.quote: Thermal Energy Materials and Physics Laboratory
TEMP Lab at UC San Diego

We are a group of scientists and engineers interested in anything related to Temperature and thermal energy, including thermal transport, conversion, storage, and management across different length scales.

we are working on developing nanostructured materials and devices for thermal to electrical energy conversion and studying fundamental transport physics of charge and heat carriers (electrons, phonons and photons) at micro and nano scale.
